records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our overall net revenue, as well as the percentage of total net revenue generated by sales in our semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software segments, have varied from quarter to quarter, due largely to fluctuations in end-market demand which are discussed in detail in Part I, Item 1A.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net revenue from our semiconductor solutions segment increased due to strong demand for our networking solutions, primarily custom AI accelerators and AI networking products.

records.text: Such revenue is reduced for estimated returns and distributor allowances.

records.text: Gross margin was $43,294 million for fiscal year 2025 compared to $32,509 million for fiscal year 2024.

records.text: Operating income from our semiconductor solutions segment increased due to strong demand for our networking solutions, primarily custom AI accelerators and AI networking products.
